# Pre-processing of Metadata

## #1 Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
data_annotation <- as.data.frame(
  read_excel(
    here("data","raw","Data_annotation_absolute_rodents.xlsx"),
    guess_max=21474835))

sample_ids <- read.csv(
  here("results","table_zenodo_mpd_id.csv"),
  fileEncoding="latin1")
```

## #3 Add Cohort and Lab Columns

```{r}
n_cols <- ncol(data_annotation)

cohort <- ifelse(
  grepl("NewITP", data_annotation[[1]]),
  str_split_i(data_annotation[[1]], "_", 5),
  NA
)

labs <- ifelse(
  grepl("NewITP", data_annotation[[1]]),
  str_split_i(data_annotation[[1]], "_", 6),
  NA
)

data_annotation$Cohort <- cohort
data_annotation$Lab <- labs

data_annotation <- data_annotation[, c(1, n_cols + 1, n_cols + 2, 2:n_cols)]
```

## #4 Change Compound Names

```{r}
interventions=intersect(sample_ids$zenodo_id,data_annotation$Intervention)

for (row in 1:nrow(data_annotation)) {
  
  if (data_annotation$Intervention[row] %in% interventions) {
    data_annotation$Intervention[row]=
      sample_ids$id[sample_ids$zenodo_id==data_annotation$Intervention[row]]
  } 
}
```

## #5 Export File as .csv

```{r}
write.csv(data_annotation,
          here("results","table_Zenodo_full.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
